item.title: Starting My Blog
item.author: sol0608sol@gmail.com (So Momma)
item.dc:creator: So Momma
item.description:
I’m an Engineer, Starting My Blog

I’ll be accumulating technical output here. Built with Hugo + Vercel for a blazing-fast environment.

Tech Stack

  • Static Site Generator: Hugo
  • Theme: hugo-brewm
  • Deployment: Vercel

I love Hugo’s simplicity and Vercel’s fast deployment.

Future Plans

  • 📝 Technical Notes: Memos of things learned and points where I got stuck during development
  • 📚 Book Reviews: Reading records of technical books and other books
  • 💭 Poems: Daily insights and thoughts as an engineer
print("Hello, ChiriTsumomma!")

I want to accumulate small learnings and connect them to great growth.
